besluite.fout: Two coordinate adjectives (lank en dun) before the noun are not separated by a comma, as the AWS requires.
besluite.rede: Adding the comma between coordinate adjectives is an AWS punctuation fix that changes nothing in the meaning and touches no protected wording.

besluite.fout: The definition of the verb 'smelt' opens with 'Wanneer', an English 'is when' construction, instead of defining the action itself.
besluite.rede: The fault is real, but this is a glossary definition shared across lessons and the rewording goes beyond a plain spelling or grammar fix, so only the writer may change it.
